# waroom_runbook (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom runbook. A runbook is identified by its path-style namespace (e.g. `/default`, `/api-server/recovery`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "waroom_runbook" "example" {
  namespace = "/api-server/recovery"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the runbook to look up, e.g. `/api-server/recovery`. The leading slash is optional.

### Read-Only

- `blob` (String) Markdown content of the runbook.
- `created_at` (String) The time the runbook was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) Runbook ID. This is the namespace as returned by Waroom, with a leading slash (e.g. `/api-server/recovery`).
- `updated_at` (String) The time the runbook was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
